g.title: uart_tx
g.text: UART Transmitter (TX): what happens on every clock tick
Each time you come back to the top of a coloured box = one clock later. N = clocks per bit. tick = (baud_cnt = N − 1).

g.title: cluster_idle
g.text: IDLE — line high, waiting for a byte

g.title: cluster_start
g.text: START — hold the line LOW for one bit time

g.title: cluster_data
g.text: DATA — put out 8 bits, LSB first, one every N clocks

g.title: cluster_stop
g.text: STOP — hold the line HIGH for one bit time
